map.由股利支付率求留存收益率: Find the retention ratio from the dividend payout ratio
map.输入股利支付率 DPR，求留存收益率。: Enter the dividend payout ratio DPR to obtain the retention ratio.
map.📖 查看「由股利支付率求留存收益率 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Find the retention ratio from the dividend payout ratio" guide
map.留存收益用于企业再投资。: Retained earnings are used for corporate reinvestment.
map.反推留存在公司的比例。: the proportion retained in the company.
map.配合 ROE 算可持续增长。: Combine with ROE to compute sustainable growth.
map.看公司留存了多少利润可用于再投资。: See how much profit the company retains for reinvestment.
map.留存率 = 1 − 40% = 60%。即盈利的 60% 留存再投资。: Retention ratio = 1 − 40% = 60%. That is, 60% of earnings is retained for reinvestment.
map.b=1−40%=60.00%，即每 1 元盈利留存 0.6 元投入经营，其余 0: b=1−40%=60.00%, i.e. 0.6 CNY of every 1 CNY of earnings is retained in the business and the remaining 0.4 CNY is paid to shareholders.
map.留存在公司就一定好？: Is retaining earnings in the company always good?
map.前提是留存再投资: The premise is that the return on retained reinvestment
map.高于股东自投回报；低效留存反损价值，需看 ROE 与投资机会。: exceeds what shareholders could earn by investing themselves; inefficient retention destroys value, so check ROE and investment opportunities.
map.留存率越高越好吗？: Is a higher retention ratio always better?
map.未必。留存率高说明内生资金充足，但只有新增资本的回报率高于股东要求回报率时才真正: Not necessarily. A high retention ratio means abundant internal funds, but value is created only when the return on new capital exceeds the return shareholders require; otherwise distributing profit to shareholders is better, and blind retention only brings inefficient expansion.
